info.title: TripPlanner Kernel API
info.description: Kernel MVP API over local curated sample data.

delete.description: Explicitly remove one durable preference group; never an implicit reset.

schema.title: Response Session Job Planning Sessions  Session Id  Job Get

ConversationEvent.title: ConversationEvent
ConversationEvent.description: A persisted, user-visible event; never a raw transcript or model trace.

CostedTrip.title: CostedTrip
CostedTrip.description:
Estimator output consumed by the optimizer (spec 02 §3, minimal for M1).

In M1 the golden harness supplies ``lines`` directly (bypassing the estimator).

PreferencePatch.title: PreferencePatch
PreferencePatch.description: Partial group replacement. Unspecified groups are preserved.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Trust metadata embedded on every fact row that can influence a recommendation.

RunnerUp.title: RunnerUp
RunnerUp.description: Second-best option for a line, for the report's 'why not X?' section.

TravelPreferenceProfile.title: TravelPreferenceProfile
TravelPreferenceProfile.description:
One user's remembered travel preferences, grouped by domain.

Every leaf is an optional ``PreferenceValue`` — absence means "never
told us," not a default choice the system silently assumed.

UserWallet.title: UserWallet
UserWallet.description: The user's owned cards + optional points balances (from TripSpec, spec 01 §8).
